inherited_exact_inputs.model: On the EXP-000789 dyadic periodic cubes, V=L^3, H_L(h)=H_L(0)-hS_L, S_L=sum_y Q_y, Q_y=8^(-1/2)sum_e q_(y,e), K_L=H_L(0)-E_(0,L)>=0, and hbar,chi,c,g,lambda>0 with A_0>J_3^2.
inherited_exact_inputs.ground_order: The unique even zero-source ground Omega_L and Phi_L=S_L Omega_L/||S_L Omega_L|| give m_L^2=<Omega_L,S_L^2 Omega_L>/V^2 with liminf m_L^2>=rho_*>0. The normalized Psi_L^sigma=(Omega_L+sigma Phi_L)/sqrt(2) has <S_L>=sigma V m_L and zero-source excess epsilon_L<=hbar^2/(4 chi V m_L^2).
inherited_exact_inputs.eventual_constants: After discarding a finite prefix, m_L^2>=rho_*/2. Define m_0=sqrt(rho_*/2) and C_e=hbar^2/(2 chi rho_*), so m_L>=m_0 and epsilon_L<=C_e/V.
inherited_exact_inputs.source_ground: For each h>0 and sigma in {-1,+1}, the real confining finite-volume Schrodinger operator H_L(sigma h) has compact resolvent and a positivity-improving heat semigroup, hence a unique strictly positive ground phi_L^sigma. Translation invariance fixes it, and parity maps phi_L^+ to phi_L^-.

mesoscopic_source_selection.definitions: Let h_L>0 tend to zero and discard a finite prefix so that h_L<=h_0. Let s_L^sigma=<phi_L^sigma,S_L phi_L^sigma> and eta_L^sigma=<phi_L^sigma,K_L phi_L^sigma>. Use Psi_L^sigma as a trial vector for H_L(sigma h_L).
mesoscopic_source_selection.near_ground_bound: If |s_L^sigma|<=C_S V, then eta_L^sigma<=C_e/V+C_S h_L V.
mesoscopic_source_selection.general_window: The two sufficient asymptotic conditions are h_L V^2->infinity and h_L V->0. The first retains nonzero order and the second kills the extensive source residual.
mesoscopic_source_selection.canonical_choice: For h_L=h_* V^(-3/2), h_L V^2=h_* V^(1/2)->infinity, h_L V=h_* V^(-1/2)->0, sigma s_L^sigma/V>=m_0-(C_e/h_*)V^(-1/2), and eta_L^sigma<=C_e V^(-1)+h_* C_S V^(-1/2)->0.
mesoscopic_source_selection.fixed_order_floor: Put m_*=m_0/2=sqrt(rho_*/8). For all sufficiently large L, sigma s_L^sigma/V>=m_*.

source_uniform_coercivity.parameters: Fix 0<gamma<g/32, a compact source interval |h|<=h_0, and a>0. Put C_gamma=max_(rho>=0)[h_0 rho-(r/2)rho^2-(g/32-gamma)rho^4].
source_uniform_coercivity.position_bound: EXP-000792 gives sum_(x in X)|q_x|^2<=a K_(L,h)+|X|/(4 a gamma). The centered even trial gives E_L(h)<=E_(0,L)<=A_s V.
source_uniform_coercivity.constants: Define B_a=a(A_s+C_gamma)+(4 a gamma)^(-1). Then S_L^2<=a V K_L+B_a V^2 as a zero-source quadratic-form inequality, while every exact source ground obeys <S_L^2><=B_a V^2 and hence |s_L^sigma|/V<=C_S:=sqrt(B_a).
source_uniform_coercivity.fourth_moment: Source coercivity and translation invariance give <|Q_0|^4>_(phi_L^sigma)<=C_4:=(A_s+C_gamma)/gamma. No additive derived constant is inserted.

zero_source_target.carrier: Use the R-167 v1.6 unital separable zero-source categorical carrier A_H^0 with ||A||_H=sup_L||pi_L^0(A)||, exact equivariance pi_L^0(theta_t A)=alpha_t^(L,0)(pi_L^0(A)), point-norm C0 shift theta, and generator delta_H.
zero_source_target.parity: Zero-source finite-volume parity induces an isometric involution gamma on A_H^0, gamma theta_t=theta_t gamma, and the source-ground pullbacks satisfy omega_L^-=omega_L^+ o gamma.
zero_source_target.graph_core: Let D_bl be the unital star-algebra generated by theta_g(B)=int g(t)theta_t(B)dt for B in A_H^0 and Schwartz g with compact Fourier support. Bandwidths add under products and flip under star. Bandlimited approximate identities converge in the graph norm of delta_H, so D_bl is a graph core.
zero_source_target.exact_defect: Differentiating exact equivariance in norm gives delta_L^0(pi_L^0(A))=pi_L^0(delta_H A) for A in D_bl. Thus the R-167 v3.9 generator defect d_L(A) is exactly zero.

form_domain_and_energy_transfer.spectral_bound: For A in D_bl choose R_A with Sp_theta(A) subset [-R_A,R_A]. Arveson energy transfer and spectral-tail integration give q_(K_L)[pi_L^0(A)phi]<=||A||_H^2(eta_L+hbar R_A).
form_domain_and_energy_transfer.domains: The spectral estimate applies to A, A^* and their products, so they preserve Dom(K_L^(1/2)). The bound S_L^2<=a V K_L+B_a V^2 makes S_L K_L^(1/2)-bounded and makes the zero-source and source quadratic forms share one form domain.
form_domain_and_energy_transfer.pairing_rule: Every occurrence of A_L^*[S_L,A_L] denotes the represented form pairing <A_L phi,S_L A_L phi>-<A_L phi,A_L S_L phi>. It is not asserted to be a bounded operator commutator.

combined_residual_closure.energy_identity: For A in D_bl, the exact quadratic-form commutator identity is cal E_L^sigma(A)=q_(H_L(sigma h_L)-E_L(sigma h_L))[A_L phi_L^sigma]=-i hbar omega_L^sigma(A^*delta_H A)-sigma h_L <phi_L^sigma,A_L^*[S_L,A_L]phi_L^sigma>=0.
combined_residual_closure.bound: |R_L^sigma(A)|<=h_L||A||_H^2{sqrt[a V(eta_L+hbar R_A)+B_a V^2]+sqrt[a V eta_L+B_a V^2]}=O(h_L V)->0.
combined_residual_closure.conclusion: R-167 v3.9 applies separately to both signs. Every joint weak-star cluster pair consists of theta-invariant algebraic ground states of the same zero-source categorical system. The R-167 v1.6 negative-Arveson estimate with eta_L->0 gives an independent proof of groundness.

fixed_witness_separation.static_witness: Put X=sqrt(8)Q_0, M_3=(64 C_4)^(3/4), and choose one fixed positive rational r_w with r_w^2 M_3<=3 sqrt(8)m_*. Then d=r_w sqrt(8)m_*/2>0 and eventually omega_L^+(sin(r_w X))>=d while omega_L^-(sin(r_w X))<=-d.
fixed_witness_separation.carrier_witness: For fixed T>0 let f_T(t)=T^(-1)(1-|t|/T)_+ and xi=r_w(1,...,1). The single b=[A_(xi,f_T)-A_(-xi,f_T)]/(2i) lies in A_H^0, is odd, self-adjoint and contractive.
fixed_witness_separation.separation: Eventually omega_L^+(b)>=d/2 and omega_L^-(b)<=-d/2. Every joint cluster pair obeys omega_-=omega_+ o gamma and ||omega_+-omega_-||>=d.

branch_and_scope_split.EXP781: EXP-000781 concerns fixed-positive-beta Euclidean DLR and locally normal time-zero tangent states, not these zero-temperature carrier grounds.
branch_and_scope_split.EXP790: EXP-000790 first takes L->infinity at fixed h and then h->0. The present h_L diagonal clusters are not proved equal to those iterated tangent candidates because no near-zero uniform finite-size rate is available.
branch_and_scope_split.v1_6: R-167 v1.6 used hand-built zero-source approximate doublets. The new theorem starts from exact finite-volume plus/minus source ground vectors and closes the model-specific R-167 v3.9 residual on an explicit graph core.
branch_and_scope_split.v3_8: R-167 v3.8 is a fixed-beta source-family KMS theorem whose selected states are not proved to factor through its zero-source quotient. The present theorem evaluates source-ground vectors directly through zero-source representations and proves no v3.8 quotient factorization.
branch_and_scope_split.categorical_boundary: A_H^0 is categorical and nonspatial. It is not the sought all-exhaustion quasi-local raw oscillator dynamics, and temporal smearing does not create a spatial local net.
